card.name: Words inside patient-condition clauses
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a clause describing a patient's state or history, such as 'who had been', 'volume-depleted', 'such as severe', or 'children with'. The next words usually name a condition or prior treatment.

modes.label: Patient-status clause
modes.description: Verb or linking word in a 'patients who had/have been...' phrase.
modes.example: in patients who had<< been>> treated with donepezil 10

modes.label: Risk-condition words
modes.description: Part of a condition or qualifier that introduces a risk group.
modes.example: patients taking diuretics, and those who are volume-de<<pleted>> may be at greater risk of developing hy

modes.label: General prose
modes.description: Mid-clause words in ordinary non-medical sentences.
modes.example: allowed men to vote without owning<< property>>, and created public schools.
